vaneris.name: Duchy of Vaneris
vaneris.desc: The northern chill, sanctuary of mana stones and magitech.

nordnia.name: Nordnia Empire
nordnia.desc: The center of the continent, the sacred imperial family.

esvard.name: Duchy of Esvard
esvard.desc: The southern flame, cradle of strong knights and military might.

nordnia.title: Nordnia Empire

facts.featureDesc: Existence of magic, spirits, and aura

nordnia.desc: The hegemon of the continent and the center of the world. A massive empire where power and balance are maintained by the imperial family and the two duchies.
nordnia.familyLineage: Contract with the Spirit Kings. High spirit sensitivity passed down through generations.
nordnia.familyDesc: A sacred bloodline inheriting the powers of the sun and light. Valuing harmony and vitality over martial might, they act as the mediator between the two duchies.

characters.name: Lauritz von Nordnia
characters.title: Crown Prince
details: Striking appearance with golden hair and silver eyes.
A powerful elementalist contracted with the Spirit King of Light.
Friendly and relaxed demeanor that makes people comfortable.
Skilled at making slick jokes to ease tension.
Managing imperial affairs in place of the retired Emperor.
Suffering from chronic fatigue despite his appearance.
A key figure watching the conflict between the duchies up close.
characters.imageCaption: * Lauritz's image is not output during RP

nordnia.locationsDesc: The heart of the empire. A megacity where splendid marble and cutting-edge facilities harmonize.

locations.title: Imperial Palace
locations.subtitle: Symbol of the Empire
locations.summary: Venue for the grand council and the Imperial Library.
details: Weekly grand council every Monday. Heads of the two duchies must attend.
Preserves rare books in the Imperial Library.
The library's back door connects to the research district.

locations.title: Kardia Square
locations.subtitle: Meeting Place
locations.summary: The central square of the capital. Hosts seasonal grand festivals.
locations.details: Features a central garden, a large fountain, and a clock tower. A popular resting place and date spot.

locations.title: Nocturne District
locations.subtitle: Back Alleys
locations.summary: Unstable security but home to many famous eateries.
locations.details: Located on the outskirts. Dense with information brokers and black markets. Famous for its junk food eateries.

locations.title: Argen Forest
locations.subtitle: Hunting Ground
locations.summary: Vast monster hunting area in the northwest.
locations.details: A vast forest in the northwest. Frequently used as a combat training ground for knights and academy cadets.

locations.title: Research District
locations.subtitle: Academic Center
locations.summary: A dense area of academic institutions and research facilities.
locations.details: Lined with massive bookstores and general stores, it is a place of knowledge where countless scholars and researchers of the Empire live and interact.

locations.title: Kunsthal
locations.subtitle: Art and Socializing
locations.summary: Developed with art galleries, grand theaters, and social clubs.
locations.details: The center of aristocratic socializing. Art galleries, grand theaters, social clubs, and tearooms are highly developed.

locations.title: Glanz
locations.subtitle: Commerce and Trends
locations.summary: A dense area of luxury shopping streets and famous dessert shops.
locations.details: The shopping street that appears past Kunsthal. It leads trends with a high concentration of high-end clothing, accessories, and famous dessert spots.

locations.title: Cathedral
locations.subtitle: Religion and Socializing
locations.summary: Regular aristocratic prayer meetings held on the 30th of every month (mandatory).
locations.details: It is both a sacred religious facility and a major meeting place for nobles. Recently, a holy relic that tells fortunes in love has become famous and is very popular among young noblewomen.

nordnia.capitalDesc: The heart of the Empire. A massive city where splendid marble and cutting-edge facilities harmonize.

east.title: Eastern Empire
east.subtitle: Granaries and Orchards
east.desc: The largest granary of the Empire. Boasts abundant agricultural production with developed large orchards.
east.cityDesc: The central city of the East. Famous for producing high-quality wine and distilled spirits.

west.title: Western Empire
west.subtitle: Trade and Coast
west.desc: A vast coastal area facing the ocean. The center of external cultural influx and maritime trade.
west.cityDesc: The largest trading port in the West. Generates immense wealth through the trade of monster byproducts and rare spices.

vaneris.title: Duchy of Vaneris
vaneris.desc: A sanctuary of magitech standing tall in the northern blizzards. Driving the empire's magical and academic advancements with abundant mana stone resources.

locations.title: Bellanova
locations.subtitle: Capital
locations.desc: The largest city in the north. A dazzling magical city showcasing cutting-edge magitech.

locations.title: Znaum
locations.subtitle: Research City
locations.desc: The Vaneris Magic Academy. The center of magitech and various academic researches.

locations.title: Belgora
locations.subtitle: Permafrost Mountains
locations.desc: Massive snowy mountains and glaciers. The north's premier resort for skiing and snowboarding.

vaneris.familyLineage: Divine nature of Ice, Abyss, and Wisdom
vaneris.familyDesc: A prestigious magic family producing archmages for generations. Driving the empire's magitech advancement with high intellectual curiosity.

characters.name: Leonid Vaneris
characters.title: Duke of Vaneris
details: Great pride in magic and knowledge, well-versed in various fields.
A reliable patriarch with a strong sense of responsibility.
Appears gruff but is endlessly generous to his family.
Prefers logical and systematic thinking.
A workaholic who ignores his surroundings when immersed in research.
Calls his rival, the Duke of Esvard, a 'barbaric bear'.
Secretly loves sweets (especially macarons).

characters.name: Kazimir Vaneris
characters.title: Young Duke / Next Head
details: A magic prodigy who received systematic education since childhood.
Values knowledge and etiquette, reacting strictly to behavior that falls below his standards.
Has a strong sense of intellectual superiority, calling others 'ignorant masses' without hesitation.
Maintains a polite gentlemanly demeanor towards ladies but is much stricter towards men.
Considers Esvard's young duke Hakon as his rival and believes himself superior in all aspects except swordsmanship.
His pride is hurt when the public evaluates him on a similar level to Hakon.
Loves sweets very much and exercises consistently to maintain his physique. Has a weakness of being afraid of ghosts.
Scent: A blend of neroli and subtle lily.

characters.name: Ingrid Vaneris
characters.title: Lady
details: A proud and confident girl who believes she is the center of the world.
Weak to praise and clearly shows her mood or dissatisfaction on her face.
Particularly sensitive to being treated as a lady due to her brother's protection and strict education.
Extremely dislikes Esvard's second son Egil, treating him like a wild horse.
Obsessed with proving her superiority against Egil.
Enjoys reading romance novels and secretly admires the Crown Prince.
Extremely hates bugs with many legs and has a constitution that reacts poorly to cheap fabrics.
Scent: A refreshing blend of lemon and sweet plum.

specialties.title: Mana Stones
specialties.subtitle: Core Resource
specialties.summary: Minerals mined throughout the Vaneris territory.
specialties.details: The core resource powering northern magitech. The source of Vaneris's immense wealth and technological prowess.

specialties.title: Tumbleroot
specialties.subtitle: Rare Alpine Monster
specialties.summary: A plump and round specialty monster living in Belgora.
details: Excellent for muscle synthesis and stamina recovery.
Outstanding flavor similar to chicken.
Grows root-legs and attempts to flee the moment it's plucked.
Has a cute habit of tripping and rolling as soon as it starts running.

esvard.title: Duchy of Esvard
esvard.desc: The shield of the south, where warm sunlight and vast plains unfold. A proud region boasting strong knights and military might.

locations.title: Skaldheim
locations.subtitle: Capital
locations.desc: The largest fortress city in the south. The center of unshakeable border defense.

locations.title: Cantarel
locations.subtitle: Great Forest
locations.desc: A massive southern forest area with endless gentle hills.

esvard.familyLineage: Divine nature of Flame, War, and Storm
esvard.familyDesc: Acting as the empire's shield by fending off external enemies with overwhelming martial prowess. Prioritizes military strength and swordsmanship.

characters.name: Astrid Esvard
characters.title: Duke of Esvard
details: Values the honor and traditions of her family above all else.
Usually maintains dignity, but erupts like a volcano when lines are crossed.
Bold and generous, but holds grudges against insults to family honor.
Casually proposes lethal stratagems using elegant aristocratic vocabulary.
Trusts hands-on experience and skill over pedantic theory.
Acknowledges Leonid's skill but dislikes him personally.
Has a surprising hobby of hunting giant monsters herself.

characters.name: Håkon Esvard
characters.title: Young Duke / Next Head
details: An outstanding heir well-versed in culture, etiquette, stamina, and swordsmanship.
Coolly accepts the results of a fair fight, even acknowledging his opponent.
Still shows traces of puberty and is sensitive when his boundaries are crossed.
In a fierce rivalry with Vaneris's young duke Kazimir.
Responds firmly and coldly the moment an opponent messes with his family.
Has calm hobbies of collecting magic items and visiting art galleries.
Scent: A calm cedarwood scent brushed with ginger.

characters.name: Egil Esvard
characters.title: Second Son
details: Has a strong desire to prove his presence in the shadow of his outstanding brother.
The type to easily cause trouble the moment he is sure a plan will succeed.
Weak to praise and has an honest personality whose mood quickly improves when recognized.
Respects his brother but harbors subtle competitiveness. Currently in a rebellious puberty phase.
In a feud with Vaneris Lady Ingrid where they provoke each other's pride whenever they meet.
Has a peach allergy. Enjoys reading heroic tales of the continent.
Scent: A sweet green apple-like scent.

specialties.title: Southern Stallions & Meat
specialties.subtitle: Main Industry
specialties.summary: Breeding of premium horses and livestock.
specialties.details: Livestock farming using the vast plains is highly developed. Leads the horse racing industry and supplies quality meat empire-wide.

specialties.title: Meatcap
specialties.subtitle: Rare Mushroom Monster
specialties.summary: A mobile mushroom monster living only in Cantarel.
details: Moves freely on thin mycorrhizal legs under its cap.
Adults are about the size of a chicken.
Deep and rich beef flavor.
Excellent for mana recovery and focus enhancement when consumed.
